{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
treatment_response_rate = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

print(f'Treatment arm size: {len(treatment_arm)}')
print(f'Number responded: {treatment_arm["responded"].sum()}')
print(f'Response fraction: {treatment_response_rate:.4f}')"}
